info.title: Starforge Edu API
info.description: Multi-tenant education-center platform API. Every response uses one envelope: success `{success:true, data, pagination?}`, error `{success:false, code, message, errors?}`. Auth is an opaque session-key Bearer token (see the `sessionAuth` scheme). The tenant is selected by the request Host (a center subdomain); a mobile app resolves it first via `GET /api/v1/platform/resolve/?slug=<center>`. See `agents/API-CONTRACT.md` for the full narrative and field-level detail.
